summary: A fire at Shakti Components Pvt Ltd (SUP-1008) has halted production for 48 hours starting 2026-12-02. Two purchase orders for Bracket 501 (PO-1001 and PO-1002) totaling 6500 units are affected, with INR 491400.00 at risk. Current inventory across DC-CHENNAI and DC-PUNE provides only 1.5 days of coverage against demand, and both POs will experience shortages. The supplier's production capacity and restart date are unknown.
facts: SUP-1008 (Shakti Components Pvt Ltd) status is ACTIVE.
PO-1001 is for 4000 units of ITM-501 (Bracket 501) at INR 75.60 per unit, due 2026-12-03, status OPEN.
PO-1002 is for 2500 units of ITM-501 (Bracket 501) at INR 75.60 per unit, due 2026-12-04, status OPEN.
ITM-501 inventory at DC-CHENNAI: 800 units on hand, daily demand 150 units.
ITM-501 inventory at DC-PUNE: 1100 units on hand, daily demand 600 units.
Alternate supplier SUP-2001 can supply ITM-501 with 2 days lead time at INR 84.00 per unit, capacity 5000 units.
Alternate supplier SUP-2002 can supply ITM-501 with 5 days lead time at INR 79.50 per unit, capacity unknown.

estimates.statement: PO-1001 for 4000 units of ITM-501 will be delayed by 2 days.
estimates.basis: Impact calculation shows estimated_delay_days of 2 for PO-1001.

estimates.statement: PO-1002 for 2500 units of ITM-501 will be delayed by 1 day.
estimates.basis: Impact calculation shows estimated_delay_days of 1 for PO-1002.

estimates.statement: PO-1001 will result in a shortage of ITM-501.
estimates.basis: Impact calculation shows shortage: true for PO-1001, with inventory_coverage_days of 1.5.

estimates.statement: PO-1002 will result in a shortage of ITM-501.
estimates.basis: Impact calculation shows shortage: true for PO-1002, with inventory_coverage_days of 1.5.

assumptions: The outage duration in the event is accurate.
Daily demand rates for ITM-501 remain constant during the disruption period.
Inventory records reflect actual available stock at the time of the event.
Alternate suppliers can fulfill orders within their stated lead times.
The fire affects only Line 2 and does not impact other production lines or the entire facility.
